name: ResolveMarriageCrisis
description: Settle the marriage crisis with the player. 'reconcile' only if the player showed real remorse and you clearly agree to stay together; 'divorce' only if you clearly say the marriage is over; otherwise 'undecided'.
note: Needs M.A.R.A.S, Mantella Living World - Relationships and Mantella's Advanced Actions. Asks the player Yes/No first, once per game day per NPC; choosing No blocks a retry that day.

decision.description: One word: reconcile, divorce or undecided.

prompt: When your latest words decide the marriage crisis, begin your response with '{key}:'
